Rich already supports this. Pass `show_header=False` to the `Table` constructor and the header row, and its separator, are not rendered:

```python
from rich.table import Table

table = Table(show_header=False)
table.add_row("A", "B", "C")
```

The option is documented in [tables.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst). For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
